value_correctness.summary: Verified in whole SAR: FY2025 (EY), FY2024, FY2023, the nine-month transition period 2022-04-01 to 2022-12-31, and H1 2026 (3M and 6M). FY2025: revenue 2,288,296,428; gross profit 1,934,616,283; profit before net finance costs 2,015,142,759 (includes net fair value gain on investment properties 501,171,226 and other operating income 312,959,295); profit before zakat 1,323,159,842; profit 1,276,159,843 (owners 1,266,893,372, NCI 9,266,471); EPS 2.67; total assets 36,892,157,366; liabilities 21,326,767,102; equity 15,565,390,264; CFO 1,783,562,209; CFI -1,157,982,696; CFF 2,997,668,216; cash 4,293,589,740 (rolls exactly, no FX line). FY2024: revenue 2,344,038,571; profit 1,224,163,900; total assets 31,452,545,879; CFO 1,006,385,476. FY2023: revenue 2,253,673,262; profit 1,500,995,182 (includes gain on disposal of investment property 238,668,127 in cash flow); total assets 27,751,227,420; CFO 1,383,597,758. Transition 9M 2022: revenue 1,687,534,280; profit 836,993,094; total assets 25,876,858,984. H1 2026: revenue 1,151,923,190; profit 592,623,857; total assets 35,134,671,838; cash 614,362,718 after repaying 3.28 billion of loans from the 2025 cash balance; Q2 2026 as printed: revenue 569,373,497, profit 389,362,050. Cash flows are year-to-date (H1 2026 cash flow is six months only; no quarterly cash flow is printed), income statements of interims carry both 3M and 6M columns. Revenue of one fiscal year is not comparable with another across the March to December fiscal change: the filings themselves say so (note 1).

document_completeness.summary: All five read filings contain the full BS, P&L, OCI, equity and cash-flow statements. The inventory misclassifies them for image-only or scanned pages: 0fa3978a (complete audited FY2024 FS, 58 pages, pages 9-58 textless) is 'other_no_statements_found'; 78e4dbd4 (H1 2026) is 'partial' (statement pages 4-10 textless); 47e41c1c, 1d675c4d, c38a2296 (35 to 37 page scanned interims) are 'scanned_unreadable' and aa56af2d, 97eea52f 'partial' with a single page recognised; 98b1f598, d288393b, 0496d1ff, 4879193d are 'other_no_statements_found' but are 31 to 33 page interim FS by their covers. PERIOD LABELS ARE UNRELIABLE FOR TWO REASONS. (1) Fiscal year ended 31 March until 2022 and changed to 31 December from the nine-month period to 2022-12-31: collector labels assume a March year end for earlier files (press release 'FY2022' is the year ended 2022-03-31; 4e2b90de labelled 2021|9M is the Q3 FY2021 release for 2020-12-31) and inventory fiscal_year_end_month is 3 with an expected window to 2027|Q1, which misstates expected periods after 2022. (2) Annual FS carry the label of the following year: 64c5dbde (nine months to 2022-12-31) is 2023|FY, 310cb87e (FY2023) is 2024|FY, 0fa3978a (FY2024) is 2025|FY, 18a0b461 (FY2025) is 2026|FY. Interim labels of the Dec-year-end era match their covers (78e4dbd4 2026|H1 'ended 30 June 2026', efa0b314 2025|9M, 0496d1ff 2025|H1 verified from cover text). Press releases (many files, 3 to 10 pages) are classified financial_statements or presentation in several cases (e.g. 4e2b90de, 8bc1ceef, d778d94f, ad6e7617 labelled 2027|H1 = H1 2026 release) although none contain statements. Duplicates: none identified among statement files; ad6e7617 (labelled 2027|H1) is a release for the same H1 2026.

defects.text: Fiscal year changed from March to December in 2022 (nine-month transition period); collector labels and inventory expected-period grid keep a March calendar, so the same statement can be labelled with the wrong FY and slot and expected periods after 2022 are misstated (grid extends to 2027|Q1).

Annual FS carry the label of the following year (transition period as 2023|FY, FY2023 as 2024|FY, FY2024 as 2025|FY, FY2025 as 2026|FY); the 9-month transition period would be wrongly treated as a full year.

Scanned or image-only statement files misclassified as no statements / unreadable / partial (0fa3978a, 78e4dbd4 and about 9 interim files); re-presented comparatives change gross profit, CFO and CFI of the transition period, FY2023 and FY2024; press releases classified as financial_statements.
